decisionsTitle: A line of the internal list on the Administrator's own address, as a special guest
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11, from the registrations list**, of a guest the club's partners sent, written on «Lista internă (doar notițe)» without an address: «trebuie să pot să-i dau un loc, că e de la parteneri, dar îmi cere mail… trebuie să pot să o pun și fără mail; momentan doar dacă aș marca-o ca elită aș putea». «Mută pe lista oficială» and «Oferă-i un loc acum» (§888) ask the person's address, because the official list sends the person the declaration; «Mută pe lista de elită» (§903) asks none, because it registers nobody. A partners' guest who should run, sign and wear a number had no door.

**Decision.** A fourth one-press verb on a line of the internal list, the Administrator's alone: **«Pe adresa mea, invitat special»**. The line's person is registered on **the pressing Administrator's own address** and put on «Lista de invitați speciali» (§643) in the same transaction, before the allocator runs.

- **Whose address.** `staff_users.email` of the actor, read by the actor's id inside the transaction and canonicalized by the versioned canonicalizer as every address is (§10.4) — never an address posted by the form, which is ignored. Every email of the registration goes there: the Administrator forwards the declaration's email to the person. A staff member's address as a participant's was never forbidden (§48).
- **The place.** The mark is written in the update that vouches for the address (`vouchAndAllocate`; on a restart, in the carried fields), so when `allocateOrWaitlist` runs it finds a row outside the places and seats it `PENDING_DECLARATION` whatever the counts, with the vouched hold's own deadline (`computeVouchedPlaceExpiry`). On a free race, a full race, a full race whose waiting list is at its limit and a race with «Fără listă de așteptare» alike: never a counted place, never `WAITLISTED`, never refused by the line's limit (the door's `assertWaitlistCanTakeOneMore` is not asked, as for an invitation, §647), never «Ești pe lista de așteptare», no verification email, the ordinary declaration email. Like every outside row's hold it is left by the maintenance run and by the deadline's release (§914) until the start.
- **The capacity formula is untouched** (`AGENTS.md` §10.6). No new term and no new condition in the allocator: an outside row consuming no place is the formula's one existing exclusion, and the allocator only honours a mark already written when it runs. Nobody waiting is passed over, because no counted place is taken; the occupied count is the same before and after.
- **The switch.** Only while the event's «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» is on (§647, §648): read under the lock and refused `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` before anything is written, in the service and again in `submitRegistration`. With the switch off, the line says in one sentence where it is switched on («Lista publică a participanților» in the event's settings) and draws no button the server would refuse. After the start the press is refused (`VOUCHED_ENTRY_AFTER_START`, §637, §872) and not drawn.
- **Several people on one address** (§389, §493). The staff entry's own rule decides, by the name: this runner already on the address is refused `ALREADY_ON_ADDRESS`, an address at the club's limit («Maxim de înscrieri pe o adresă (pe eveniment)») `ADDRESS_AT_CAP`, each with the staff entry's existing sentence said on the line and nothing written. Two presses at once for one address one below the limit serialise on the event row's lock: every press locks the event row first (`lockEventForCapacity`, the lock every allocation takes) and reads which runners the address holds only under it, so the second waits for the first's commit, finds the address at the limit and is refused; `tests/concurrency/own-address-guest.test.ts` presses three at once and finds one registration and two refusals.
- **One transaction under one event lock**: the role (asserted in the service and again in the action), the switch, the start, the line, the vouched entry with the mark, the line's note onto the registration (§777), the line deleted. Any refusal writes nothing and the line keeps its note.
- **Asked first**, in plain words: the person is registered on your address (shown), the emails come to you; it is a special guest, no place of the announced ones, and the place is not released for want of a signature; the declaration is the person's own — from the link in the email you forward, or on paper at the start. The same relay tick as the move («Confirm că această persoană mi-a cerut să o înscriu…», §33), by the same mechanism. The toast after the press is fixed words that say the next step.
- **The trail**: `registration.created_by_staff`, `registration.address_vouched_on_entry`, `registration.outside_capacity_changed` (`from: false`, `to: true`) and `event_reserve.moved`, each as its verb writes it today, the first, the third and the fourth tagged `via: "ownAddressGuest"` — ids only, never a name, an address or the note.

**Amends §888** (the internal list's one-press verbs gain a fourth) and **§643, §648** (one more door onto «Lista de invitați speciali»: at the entry, before the allocation, under the same switch and lock). **Stands on §389 and §493** (several people on one address, decided by the name at a staff entry, within the club's limit).

**What does not change.** The declaration stays the person's own: no staff-signed declaration; «Confirmă pe hârtie» at the start records the paper the person signed and names the staff member who recorded it. **§903's refusal of an address-less registration stands**: every registration still has an address — here the Administrator's — because the declaration, its link and its PDF need one; the elite list remains the only way to print a name with no registration at all.

**Decided without the owner** (the sensible default, each one line to change): the address is the pressing Administrator's own, not a chosen colleague's nor a club mailbox; the press is on every line, with an address or without, since the address used is always the Administrator's; the person's emails leave in the backoffice's language and the public list is opted out (§323), as from the move; the button is not offered after the start, where the desk takes a person.

**Refused.** A registration with no address at all (§903; §10.8 — a declaration needs an address to reach the person). An address typed beside the button for the Administrator's (a forgeable post naming somebody else's inbox). A counted place or the waiting list for the guest (it would take one of the announced places from somebody waiting, or be refused by the line's limit — the owner asked for a partner's guest, which is what the special guests list is for). A staff-signed declaration. A new club setting or a "partner" mark: nothing the request needs.
changelogLine: - **«Pe adresa mea, invitat special» on a line of the internal list** — an Administrator registers a person with no address of their own, a partners' guest say, on their own address and on «Lista de invitați speciali» in one press: no announced place taken, nobody waiting passed over, and the declaration still the person's own, from the forwarded email or on paper at the start. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a line of an event's internal list and the event's «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» on, when an Administrator presses «Pe adresa mea, invitat special» and confirms its dialog — which shows the Administrator's own address, says the emails go there, that the place is outside the announced ones and not released unsigned and that the declaration is the person's own, and asks the relay tick — then in one transaction under the event lock the person is registered on the Administrator's `staff_users.email` (an address posted by the form is ignored), marked outside the places before the allocator runs, and ends `PENDING_DECLARATION` with the vouched hold's deadline on a free race, a full race, a full race whose waiting list is at its limit and a race with no waiting list alike, the occupied count unchanged; exactly one declaration email is queued to that address and no waiting-list or verification email; the line's note moves onto the registration and the line is deleted; the trail rows carry ids and the tag `ownAddressGuest` only; the press returns to the same list with a toast of fixed words; with the switch off the line says where to switch it on and draws no button, and the press is refused `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`; after the start it is refused `VOUCHED_ENTRY_AFTER_START`; the same name on the address or the address at the club's limit is refused with the staff entry's sentence; every refusal writes nothing. Verification: integration `registrations/internal-list-own-address-guest.test.ts`, `registrations/internal-list-own-address-screens.test.ts` (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A registration put on «Lista de invitați speciali» by «Pe adresa mea, invitat special» consumes no place and adds no term to the capacity formula; its hold is left by the maintenance run and by the deadline's release until the start, and «Confirmă pe hârtie» confirms it; three presses at once for one address one below the club's limit per address, on separate real connections from one pool, end with exactly one registration and two `ADDRESS_AT_CAP` refusals, the refused lines kept. Verification: integration `registrations/internal-list-own-address-guest.test.ts`, concurrency `own-address-guest.test.ts` (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Pe adresa mea, invitat special» is the Administrator's alone: its button, its question and the switch-off sentence are drawn for the Administrator only, the Organizer seeing none of them, and an Organizer's or Tehnic's forged post is refused at the action's door and by the service with nothing written. Verification: integration `registrations/internal-list-own-address-guest.test.ts`, `registrations/internal-list-own-address-screens.test.ts` (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
